column1: # RECOIL has no Nintendo console formats, so every row is a divergence. Evidence by group:

# - rgbgfx (Game Boy): RGBDS rgbgfx (MIT, built from source at d73a05a) run as a black box. `rgbgfx -r` renders the same files, and the source PNGs of the generated sets are pixel-exact oracles after RGB555 quantization. Transparent colors keep alpha 0; flattened over the gray 0xc0c0c0 the output matches them.
# - GBA `.4bpp`/`.8bpp`: SuperFamiconv v0.12 (MIT) in gba and gba_affine modes, run as a black box on its own native data.

# - Nitro (DS: NCLR, NCGR, NSCR, BTX0) and 3DS (CLIM, CTPK, CTXB): no free real sample exists, so these files are synthetic, written by a script from the NitroPaint, GBATEK and Khronos ETC1 layouts. Evidence is self-consistency only, except the ETC1 block decoder, which matches texture2ddecoder (MIT) on random blocks and etcpak output (BSD-3). All unverified against real files.

column4: 3DS CLIM texture, format a4; RECOIL does not support it. Synthetic file written by a script from the GBATEK layouts (no real sample of this format was available, so it is unverified); the decoded picture equals the script's source image after the format's quantization, flattened over the gray c0c0c0, pixel for pixel. Bottom-row-first storage and the crop anchor (the upper left of the flipped padded texture) are guesses, see texture.rs. Alpha is kept: rgb() is black where alpha is 0, and flattened over gray c0c0c0 the output equals the one reviewed before.

3DS CLIM texture, ETC1; RECOIL does not support it. Synthetic file: the blocks were written by etcpak (BSD-3, run as a black box) from a synthetic image and rearranged to the GBATEK layout by script (no real sample of this format was available, so it is unverified). The decoded picture equals texture2ddecoder's (MIT, black box) decode of the same blocks, composited on the shared gray, pixel for pixel; 3DS-specific parts (little-endian blocks, Z-order tiles, ETC1A4 alpha) are from GBATEK; bottom-row-first rows and the crop anchor (the upper left of the flipped padded texture) are guesses, see texture.rs. The block decoder also matched texture2ddecoder on 2,000 random blocks
